headline: SEA @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 3.70 at OAK 3.33, with a projected total of 7.02. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward OAK: SEA moved -0.98 runs while OAK moved -0.76, changing the projected margin by -0.22 runs. The projected total fell -1.74, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Emerson Hancock has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Nick Kurtz, Julio Rodríguez, Darell Hernaiz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rob Refsnyder, Lawrence Butler because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
